title: Sweep permanently fails priming requests on GROBID outage
description:
Found by the Cyclotron session (read-only; refs at origin/main a35694b).

When GROBID is unreachable (reason codes `grobid_unreachable` or `grobid_request_failed`) the sweep marks the priming request permanently failed and never retries (see the failed-status handling in `src/papyrus_content/priming_http.py` around lines 98-100 and the curation call in `priming_curation.py:46`). That is an infrastructure outage, not a per-URL failure.

```gherkin
Feature: GROBID outage handling
  Scenario: GROBID is down during a sweep
    Given GROBID is unreachable
    When the sweep applies a priming request
    Then the request stays retryable (not permanently failed)
    And it is retried once GROBID is live again
```
Acceptance: either infrastructure reason codes map to a retryable state, or a GROBID liveness preflight runs before any request is applied; per-URL failures stay terminal; spec covers both.
Depends on the reason-code ticket for the error detail.
